implementation.scope: Four public DOM helpers: hideOthers, inertOthers, suppressOthers and supportsInert. No upstream runtime or tslib.

changes: Independent per-attribute ownership for mixed aria/inert calls.
Idempotent undo restores original attribute values and preserves later external changes.
Invalid targets do not hide the document; iterative traversal handles deep and nested-shadow paths.
Prototype-named markers are safe; automatic suppression uses the target document's inert support.
